name: MetaSeat: Front Row Live
summary:
The best seat in the house, wherever you are.

MetaSeat puts you inside live concerts and sports in immersive 360° video. Look all around the venue from your seat, like you are right there with the crowd.

YOUR 360° SEAT
- Pick an event and step into the venue in full 360°.
- Watch seated or standing. The camera stays put, so there is no artificial movement.
- Use your Touch controllers to move panels, set the volume or recenter your view.

REPLAYS YOUR WAY
- Scrub with the seek bar or skip 10 seconds. Meta
